Short answers from our side:
- Additional insured: Yes, we require an Additional Insured endorsement for vendors providing platform or production services. Preferred language: "Redwood Inference, its affiliates, officers, directors and employees, as additional insured, primary and noncontributory." If you cannot add that exact language, please flag the differences and we’ll review.
- Waiver of subrogation: Not required in most cases, but can be helpful for certain SOWs — Procurement will confirm if this engagement needs it.
- Certificate holder wording: Please list: "Redwood Inference, 425 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105" as the certificate holder.

Next steps:
1) Please attach an endorsement or revised COI showing Redwood as additional insured.
2) If available, provide your W9/EIN document. If you prefer, upload both to our vendor portal (link below) — otherwise reply to this thread.
3) Priyom will issue the PO once paperwork is updated and billing contact is confirmed.

Vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/upload (preferred)
PO template (for your reference): Redwood_Procurement_PO_Template.docx

Thanks — I’ll track this on the CloudSync deal.

— Logan
